archetypes.name: postmerge-route-auditor
archetypes.rationale: Ship routing changes can silently alter merge recovery semantics.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the closed-PR pre-fix rebase guard for route ordering and state invariants. Check that PR_CLOSED skip cannot mask active rebase or conflict handoffs and still allows postmerge-push-watch reship to re-check main health. Verify docs and tests pin the closed-PR carve-out without weakening open-PR ci-fix or reship behavior. Cite each finding with file paths and symbols from the plan or repository evidence. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
